disclaimer: Illustrative ranges from public forums, physician communities, and aggregated salary reports (2024–2026). Not MGMA/AMGA data. Use for negotiation context only; enter licensed benchmarks you have rights to use in the Benchmarks tab.

cme.source: SDN contract threads; typical offer terms

pain.label: Interventional Pain
workflowHints: Document ASC buy-in and procedure-site restrictions separately from hospital non-compete.
Prior-auth denial rate in Volume affects whether wRVU targets are realistic.
Compare bonus conversion on wRVUs above threshold only vs all wRVUs.
redFlags: Non-compete covering all procedure sites
Uncompensated APP supervision with high volume
Productivity threshold above 90th percentile production

peds.label: Outpatient Pediatrics
peds.callPayNight: Often unpaid (built into base); nursery call varies
workflowHints: Panel size and inbox hours in Volume — panels above 2200 are aggressive per AMA/MGMA guidance.
Newborn nursery and weekend clinic obligations belong in checklist + contract diligence.
Score lifestyle only after documenting call and inbox burden.
redFlags: Broad non-compete for all outpatient pediatrics
Panel attribution without support staff
Quality metrics tied to access without same-day slots

anesthesia.label: Anesthesiology
workflowHints: Log post-call day off policy in Volume — not just call nights/month.
Medical direction vs supervision billing affects true hourly value.
Hospital contract loss clause is critical for employed groups.
redFlags: No post-call recovery day with heavy in-house call
wRVU target misaligned with ASA unit reality
Group non-compete spanning entire health system

derm.label: Dermatology
workflowHints: Separate medical vs cosmetic collections % in diligence answers.
Partnership track ~2.25 years median in community data — verify buy-in in writing.
Non-compete should be scoped: cosmetics, Mohs, telederm called out separately.
redFlags: Cosmetic revenue excluded from collections definition
Patient/social media restrictions beyond standard nonsolicit
Overhead allocation unclear in collections model

radiology.label: Radiology
workflowHints: Document night/weekend differential and internal moonlighting rights.
Telerad rates are volatile — confirm contract adjustment clauses.
Modality mix in checklist drives whether RVU targets are achievable.
redFlags: Hospital contract non-renewal without transition plan
Pure per-click telerad with unilateral rate changes
Non-compete blocking remote reads in allowed states

psych.label: Psychiatry
workflowHints: No-show policy and visit length belong in Volume — they drive effective hourly pay.
Telehealth state licensing and malpractice situs in contract diligence.
Controlled-substance / ADHD-heavy models: document DEA liability split.
redFlags: Non-compete restricting telehealth in parity states
Uncompensated crisis call
1099 platform with variable panel build risk

primary.label: Primary Care / Family Medicine
workflowHints: Negotiate max panel size in contract — above 2500 is aggressive per community norms.
Inbox/admin hours in Volume; VBC bonus historical payout in quality diligence.
Align wRVU threshold to 50th percentile (~5200), not 75th+, before scoring comp fit.
redFlags: High base with 90th percentile wRVU threshold
Quality formula changeable unilaterally
Non-compete covering entire primary-care market

em.label: Emergency Medicine
sources: ACEP survey cited in trade press
workflowHints: Normalize offers to $/hour × expected hours before comparing to wRVU-model specialties.
Document boarding burden and patients/hour in Volume — affects RVU vs hourly model choice.
1099 locums: self-employment tax and tail are your problem — use contract rows.
redFlags: CMG hourly below $235 in non-rural market
RVU bonus with <1.7 pts/hr throughput
Hospital contract loss without severance
